UpCloud.summary_note: UpCloud is a strong sovereignty story — Finnish privately held parent, EU-only investors (Tesi state fund), detailed published legal analysis confirming CLOUD Act does not apply, and EU Access Management Policy ensuring only EU employees access EU infrastructure. The key differentiator vs IONOS is the explicit legal architecture: UpCloud USA Inc. has zero control over EU customer data by design and documentation, unlike IONOS Inc. which IONOS's own white paper admits creates CLOUD Act exposure. Main weaknesses: no BSI C5 certification, no customer-managed KMS, only 70% renewable energy across data centres, and ESG reporting is early-stage with limited specific metrics. Small provider (~83–130 employees) — limited service breadth compared to OVHcloud, STACKIT, or IONOS.
